bullets.text: French Telco Consortium Bids Higher - **Bouygues**, **Orange**, and **Iliad** raise their offer for **SFR** to €20.4 billion.
5G-A Powers AI Revolution - The shift to **5G-Advanced** is crucial for handling surging **AI-driven** mobile traffic.
AI Transforms Customer Experience - **Calix** CEO highlights how **AI** can enable hyper-personalised services in telecom.
Inventory Data Gains Value - **Telcos** are realising the strategic importance of network inventory data for operational efficiency.
Nokia and Orange Collaborate - The two companies are developing **AI-RAN** technologies to enhance network performance.
Vodafone Enhances Scam Protection - New **AI-driven** scam call filter added to **Secure Net Mobile** for real-time protection.
